source_findings: The Power guard closes the real coupled cancellation before publishing the event or invoking a delayed hook.
The coupled generation prevents cancellation storage recycling until the same guard releases it.
The retained branch attempts shutdown instead of returning merely because storage is retained.
The non-destructive original shutdown protocol precedes first-transaction closing and seal.
Completed original return, exit-ready and actual current-master lock observations precede CPU joins.
Actual lock observations are repeated after the protocol and checked disable boundaries.
Independent CPU producer stops preserve the first actual failure while still attempting the remaining producers.
Snapshot copies use a separate nonblocking atomic guard; collision is explicit and diagnostics do not authorize release.
No final release, unmap, destructive-admission, ordinary unload or PM acknowledgement is granted.
frontend_precondition: Concurrent cancellation callers must hold publication references; ordinary Owner stop/free follows their joined exclusion.
